Bezika: Shopify Ecommerce Development for a Bilingual Online Store

Project Overview

Bezika is a Kuwait-focused home and lifestyle ecommerce store built on Shopify, designed to deliver a seamless online shopping experience for Arabic and English-speaking customers. The project combines modern storefront design, intuitive product discovery, and practical ecommerce functionality to create a consistent shopping experience across devices.

The Challenge

Creating an effective ecommerce storefront requires more than displaying products. Customers need to navigate collections easily, understand product offerings, discover promotions, and move through the shopping journey without unnecessary friction. For a bilingual store serving the Kuwaiti market, maintaining a consistent experience across Arabic and English adds another layer of consideration.

My Approach

I worked on Shopify storefront customization, focusing on product presentation, collection organization, responsive layouts, and the overall user experience. The goal was to create a cohesive storefront that reflects the brand's identity while making browsing and shopping straightforward.

Shopify Theme Customization

The storefront was tailored to the brand's requirements using Shopify's theme architecture and relevant frontend technologies. This involved working with Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize the presentation and functionality of the online store.

Bilingual Ecommerce Experience

The store supports Arabic and English, catering to different language preferences within its target market. The experience prioritizes clear navigation, consistent presentation, and usability across both language versions.

Product Discovery and Navigation

Product organization and collection navigation play an important role in helping customers explore a store. The storefront brings together product listings, collections, and promotional content to make browsing more intuitive.

Responsive Web Design

The storefront was developed with a focus on responsive presentation, helping customers browse the store across desktop and mobile devices while maintaining a consistent visual experience.

Technologies Used

  • Shopify: Ecommerce platform and storefront management

  • Liquid: Shopify theme templating and customization

  • JavaScript: Frontend interactions and functionality

  • HTML & CSS: Store structure, styling, and responsive layouts

Project Outcome

Bezika brings together Shopify development, ecommerce website customization, and bilingual storefront design in a cohesive online shopping experience. The project demonstrates my approach to building practical, brand-focused ecommerce websites that balance visual presentation with usability.

title: Karpus
desc: Customized a Shopify storefront for Karpus, a UAE-based accessories brand, focusing on minimalist design, product presentation, responsive layouts, and a seamless ecommerce shopping experience.

The brand focuses on understated aesthetics, everyday versatility, and thoughtfully designed accessories. The project involved customizing the Shopify storefront to reflect Karpus's visual identity while creating a clean, intuitive, and responsive online shopping experience. The website brings together product-focused layouts, collection navigation, and brand storytelling to help customers explore the available designs with ease. Product presentation needs to remain the primary focus while navigation, collection organization, and product information work together to support the customer journey. The objective was to create a Shopify storefront that communicated the brand's identity consistently, presented its products effectively, and provided a smooth browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices. My Approach My approach focused on Shopify theme customization, frontend development, and ecommerce user experience. The goal was to align the storefront with Karpus's minimalist design direction while maintaining practical functionality and a cohesive shopping journey. By combining a considered design approach with Shopify's ecommerce capabilities, the storefront provides a cohesive foundation for showcasing the brand's collections and supporting its online shopping experience.

Karpus: Shopify Development for a Minimalist Accessories Brand

Karpus is a UAE-based accessories brand specializing in minimalist bracelets that combine 925 sterling silver with premium threads. The brand focuses on understated aesthetics, everyday versatility, and thoughtfully designed accessories.

The project involved customizing the Shopify storefront to reflect Karpus's visual identity while creating a clean, intuitive, and responsive online shopping experience. The website brings together product-focused layouts, collection navigation, and brand storytelling to help customers explore the available designs with ease.

The Challenge

Building an ecommerce website for a minimalist brand requires a careful balance between visual simplicity and functionality. Product presentation needs to remain the primary focus while navigation, collection organization, and product information work together to support the customer journey.

The objective was to create a Shopify storefront that communicated the brand's identity consistently, presented its products effectively, and provided a smooth browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices.

My Approach

My approach focused on Shopify theme customization, frontend development, and ecommerce user experience. The goal was to align the storefront with Karpus's minimalist design direction while maintaining practical functionality and a cohesive shopping journey.

Shopify Theme Customization

The storefront was customized using Shopify's theme architecture to align its layouts, typography, and content sections with the brand's visual identity. The emphasis was on creating a refined interface that complements the products without introducing unnecessary visual complexity.

Product Presentation and Collection Navigation

Product discovery plays an important role in ecommerce usability. The storefront organizes bracelet collections and product listings to help customers explore different designs, understand available options, and navigate between relevant products.

Brand Identity and Visual Design

The website uses a product-focused design approach to communicate Karpus's understated aesthetic. Consistent visual elements, considered spacing, and clear content hierarchy help create a recognizable brand experience throughout the storefront.

Responsive Web Development

Responsive design was an important consideration in the storefront experience. Layouts and interface elements were tailored to support browsing across different screen sizes, helping maintain usability and visual consistency on desktop and mobile devices.

Ecommerce User Experience

The storefront brings together product information, collection browsing, and shopping functionality within a straightforward interface. The focus was on reducing unnecessary friction during product discovery and making essential information accessible throughout the customer journey.

  • Shopify Liquid: Theme templating and storefront customization

  • CSS: Layout development, styling, and responsive design

By combining a considered design approach with Shopify's ecommerce capabilities, the storefront provides a cohesive foundation for showcasing the brand's collections and supporting its online shopping experience.

title: Tesoro
desc: Developed a modern, responsive website for Tesoro, a gaming rewards platform that connects brands, merchants, and gamers through card-linked offers and in-game currency rewards.
overview: Tesoro: Building a Digital Experience for a Gaming Rewards Platform Project Overview Tesoro is a gaming rewards platform designed to connect everyday shopping with in-game rewards. By linking eligible Visa and Mastercard payment cards to participating offers, the platform enables gamers to earn virtual currency through qualifying purchases while helping merchants reach new customers and game studios create additional revenue opportunities. The project focused on presenting this innovative rewards ecosystem through a modern, engaging, and responsive website. The goal was to communicate a relatively complex business model in a way that feels intuitive to gamers, merchants, and gaming industry partners. The Challenge A platform serving multiple audiences needs a clear digital experience that communicates its value to each group without overwhelming visitors with technical details. Tesoro's website needed to explain how card-linked rewards work, demonstrate the benefits for different stakeholders, and guide visitors toward relevant information and calls to action. The challenge was to balance compelling visual storytelling with clear information architecture, accessible content, and a consistent brand experience. My Approach The approach focused on creating a structured, audience-oriented website that introduces the platform, explains its rewards mechanism, and directs visitors to dedicated sections based on their needs. Website Design and Development The website presents Tesoro as a modern gaming technology and rewards platform through a structured layout, prominent messaging, and clear content sections. The design emphasizes visual hierarchy and readability to help visitors understand the platform's purpose quickly. User Experience and Information Architecture The website organizes information around three primary audiences: gamers, merchants, and game studios. Dedicated sections help each audience explore the platform's benefits and understand how the rewards ecosystem fits their needs. <Cite refs={["turn981921view0","turn981921search4","turn981921search6"]}/> Gaming Rewards Platform Storytelling Explaining the connection between real-world purchases and virtual rewards requires a straightforward presentation of the process. The website communicates the core journey through four stages: connecting a payment card, activating an offer, completing a qualifying purchase, and receiving in-game rewards. Responsive Web Design The website was structured to provide a consistent browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices, maintaining accessible content, clear navigation, and recognizable calls to action across screen sizes. Conversion-Focused Landing Pages Calls to action, including waitlist registration and audience-specific entry points, help guide visitors toward the next step. The website's structure supports both product education and lead generation by making relevant information accessible to prospective users and business partners. Technologies and Tools Webflow: Website development and content management HTML & CSS: Page structure, styling, and responsive layouts JavaScript: Interactive functionality, where implemented Responsive Web Design: Adapting the experience across screen sizes UI/UX Design: Information hierarchy, navigation, and user journeys Project Outcome Tesoro's website presents a complex gaming rewards proposition through a structured digital experience built around its core audiences and value proposition. By combining audience-specific content, clear explanations of the rewards process, and prominent calls to action, the website helps communicate how the platform connects gaming, commerce, and loyalty. The project demonstrates my experience in website development, responsive web design, user experience, and creating digital experiences for technology-driven businesses.
overviewHtml:
Tesoro: Building a Digital Experience for a Gaming Rewards Platform

Project Overview

Tesoro is a gaming rewards platform designed to connect everyday shopping with in-game rewards. By linking eligible Visa and Mastercard payment cards to participating offers, the platform enables gamers to earn virtual currency through qualifying purchases while helping merchants reach new customers and game studios create additional revenue opportunities. 

The project focused on presenting this innovative rewards ecosystem through a modern, engaging, and responsive website. The goal was to communicate a relatively complex business model in a way that feels intuitive to gamers, merchants, and gaming industry partners.

The Challenge

A platform serving multiple audiences needs a clear digital experience that communicates its value to each group without overwhelming visitors with technical details.

Tesoro's website needed to explain how card-linked rewards work, demonstrate the benefits for different stakeholders, and guide visitors toward relevant information and calls to action. The challenge was to balance compelling visual storytelling with clear information architecture, accessible content, and a consistent brand experience.

My Approach

The approach focused on creating a structured, audience-oriented website that introduces the platform, explains its rewards mechanism, and directs visitors to dedicated sections based on their needs.

Website Design and Development

The website presents Tesoro as a modern gaming technology and rewards platform through a structured layout, prominent messaging, and clear content sections. The design emphasizes visual hierarchy and readability to help visitors understand the platform's purpose quickly.

User Experience and Information Architecture

The website organizes information around three primary audiences: gamers, merchants, and game studios. Dedicated sections help each audience explore the platform's benefits and understand how the rewards ecosystem fits their needs. <Cite refs={["turn981921view0","turn981921search4","turn981921search6"]}/>

Gaming Rewards Platform Storytelling

Explaining the connection between real-world purchases and virtual rewards requires a straightforward presentation of the process. The website communicates the core journey through four stages: connecting a payment card, activating an offer, completing a qualifying purchase, and receiving in-game rewards. 

Responsive Web Design

The website was structured to provide a consistent browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices, maintaining accessible content, clear navigation, and recognizable calls to action across screen sizes.

Conversion-Focused Landing Pages

Calls to action, including waitlist registration and audience-specific entry points, help guide visitors toward the next step. The website's structure supports both product education and lead generation by making relevant information accessible to prospective users and business partners.

Technologies and Tools

  • Webflow: Website development and content management

  • HTML & CSS: Page structure, styling, and responsive layouts

  • JavaScript: Interactive functionality, where implemented

  • Responsive Web Design: Adapting the experience across screen sizes

  • UI/UX Design: Information hierarchy, navigation, and user journeys

Project Outcome

Tesoro's website presents a complex gaming rewards proposition through a structured digital experience built around its core audiences and value proposition. By combining audience-specific content, clear explanations of the rewards process, and prominent calls to action, the website helps communicate how the platform connects gaming, commerce, and loyalty.

The project demonstrates my experience in website development, responsive web design, user experience, and creating digital experiences for technology-driven businesses.

title: Black Fridye
desc: A campaign store for a sustainable clothing label, pairing provocative storytelling with a one-service checkout.
overview: Black Fridye is a sustainable fashion initiative by Citizen Wolf, launched as an annual event every November as an ethical counter to Black Friday consumerism. Instead of buying new, customers send in their faded or worn garments to be professionally re-dyed, giving their clothes a second life and dramatically reducing textile waste. The campaign-style website is bold, provocative, and purposefully minimal, using strong typography and a high-contrast palette to challenge fast fashion norms. The e-commerce flow is streamlined around a single service, making it easy for customers to understand the process, select their garment, and book a dye job in just a few clicks.

title: Cord Studio
desc: An e-commerce storefront for contemporary clothing and premium leather goods, with bespoke monogramming.
overview: Cord Studio is an Indian contemporary fashion brand offering a curated range of clothing and premium leather goods. The brand blends modern design sensibilities with artisanal craftsmanship, releasing limited seasonal collections that celebrate quality and individuality. A standout feature of the brand is its personalised monogramming service, allowing customers to add a bespoke touch to their leather pieces. The e-commerce experience is crafted to reflect the brand's refined aesthetic, with clean layouts, editorial photography, and an intuitive shopping journey that makes luxury feel accessible and personal.

title: Avantgarde Artist Agency
desc: A booking and roster site for a London electronic music agency, built around bold, editorial layouts.
overview: Avantgarde Artist Agency is a London-based electronic music booking and management agency with over 20 years of experience in the industry. Representing more than 20 internationally acclaimed artists, the agency specialises in connecting world-class electronic music talent with promoters, festivals, and venues across the globe. The website reflects the agency's bold artistic identity, featuring a dark, immersive design with dynamic typography and a refined visual language that speaks directly to the underground music scene. The site serves as a central hub for artist discovery, tour booking, and brand communication.

title: Innovative Dental Springfield
desc: A calm, accessible site for a premium dental practice, built to drive bookings and patient confidence.
overview: Innovative Dental is a premium dental practice based in Springfield, Missouri, renowned for delivering a spa-like patient experience alongside world-class clinical care. The practice specialises in dental implants, orthodontics, and cosmetic dentistry, combining cutting-edge technology with a warm, welcoming environment that puts patient comfort first. The website was designed to communicate trust, expertise, and approachability, using clean white aesthetics and professional photography to ease patient anxiety and guide visitors through available treatments. Appointment booking and patient education are centralised for a seamless digital-to-clinic journey.
